windows.notes: Redrawn from the LIVE 100 % Deck Properties capture (ref/windows/vertical_grid.png = crop (16,79) 330x425 of dialogs/deck-properties@1x.png; windows/vertical_grid-vs-ref.png). New painted frame e.ui.vgridlook: 1 px frame (top #AAADB3, left #828790, right #9DA1A8, bottom #D2D4D7), #F0F0F0 gutter 14 px with a #A1A1A5 line, WHITE header cells (the earlier #F0F0F0 guess was wrong), 150 px header + #ABABAE/#F4F4F5 line, 19 px rows (17 + dark/light hairlines), focused row #0078D7 with white name and a dotted rectangle round its value cell, category bands 22 px with the #D2D2D2 to #B7B7B7 gradient, top/bottom lines and the double chevron (pixel table from the capture, flipped when shut), Tahoma 11 px (ink widths match Tahoma, not Segoe), names at header x+16, values at the value cell x+2. Structure (gutter, lines, band, selection) is within 2 levels per channel except the hairlines (up to 8) and the dotted rectangle; text differs by ClearType fringes only.
gaps: Row hairlines: the capture's lines sit at fractional positions and drift 0.013 px per row (dark C6 to CE, light D9 to D2); ours is a linear approximation per group, so the second category's rows differ by up to 8 levels
Text is greyscale AA; the capture is ClearType (colour fringes), ink within 1 px
The capture's Computed rows with pictures (Land/Creature/Spell, mana symbols, strategy bar, legality letters) and two-cell rows (Deck | Sideboard) are not reproduced: the sheet shows plain text rows
Dotted focus rectangle colour and phase approximate (the capture mixes #484848..#8F8F8F); its right edge dots sit on the frame column

Only the focused row is an editor in v3; editors in other rows are caller supplied (the sheet passes plain text); editing, hover and the shut band's own look are not in the capture (the down chevron is the flipped picture, a guess)
The band's right corner highlight (x 328) and the first/last band top lines blend with the frame; approximated
Neper look keeps the v2 property grid; its PNG changed only because the sheet now has the dialog's size

windows.notes: Two sheets: data_grid (flat list and grouped grid) and data_grid_main, which reproduces the two grids of the LIVE 100 % capture of the v3 main window (docs/ui/looks/ref/windows/main-window@1x.png, cropped to ref/windows/data_grid_main.png at (292,108) 500x468; windows/data_grid_main-vs-ref.png has ref left, ours right). Measured at 100 %: collection rows pitch 19 (17 face + 2 hairlines #E6/#EC), stripes start grey (#EFEFEF on the first record), header white 18 + #F7F7F7 hairline, header separators nearly invisible 2 px (#EAEAEA/#FAFAFA), pool footer #FFFFDD 20 px with a #E7EAEA Count cell under Name, collection footer #C0DCC0 with #E7EAEA sum cells, navigator 22 px, group rows pitch 18 (16 face + #E5E5E5/#E7E7E7), no '(Count: n)' on group rows, group label starts in the first column after the indicator, footer text regular (not bold), Edition/Qty/Used centred. Changes (behind gridlook.v3, new Look.group_flat): group label no count and from the Star column, footer text regular, stripe phase flipped (first record grey, matching S100 and N1 v3 captures); these also alter docs/ui/looks/windows/data_grid*.png. ROUND 3 (looks3-e): the dialogs' grids are the new sheet data_grid_dialogs (Sort dialog grid vs ref/windows/data_grid_sort.png, Missing Set Cards list vs data_grid_missing.png): TcxGrid frame (#828790 sides, #A7AAB0/#D5D7DA top), white header with the #F4F4F4 first hairline, stripes first row grey, 16 px bar with the 2 px thumb, Tahoma at text_size 11.7 (ink width of 'Mystery Booster Commander Edition' 186 vs 184 px). Reports, Show Columns and the Rules list are covered in the gaps and in tree_list.
gaps: Header height is 21 (the 150 % measurement) but the 100 % capture has 19 (18 + hairline); pool header plus filter row is 41 in v3, ours 48 (head_extra 28 vs about 20): the look has no scale so one value serves both DPIs
Group rows are 19 px pitch (uniform virtual rows); v3 draws them 18 px with #E5E5E5/#E7E7E7 lines between them, ours has no lines
Group row focus rectangle is drawn per cell with gaps and also over the indicator column; v3 draws one continuous dotted rectangle from after the indicator

Group box (plus) is black 11 px; v3's is a 9 px light box with a navy plus; filter-row '=' operator is thin and light, v3's is a thick dark bar; header sort glyph is a black arrow, v3's a light outline triangle; indicator header glyph is blue, v3's grey
Navigator buttons are plain blue arrows without the button chrome and pictures of v3 (the icon files are not in this repo); the first/prior/next/last/funnel/jump glyphs are guessed shapes

Name column of the collection grid colours Tangle and Silkguard black in v3 but the row ink is per row (ours green); the orange card-back disc and the black Forest picture are plain discs; the grid backdrop picture below the rows is not drawn; the Edition symbol and Legal letters are not drawn

The sheet passes height+22 to dg.build because the grid reserves 52 px for the navigator while v3's is about 30; the collection grid shows a vertical thumb that v3 does not, and ends 16 px short of the frame
Text is Segoe UI 10.35 px greyscale; the capture is ClearType and its group-row text is about 13 % wider (Tahoma 8?), unconfirmed
The last column 'Se' is a 12 px column to mimic the clipped one; the pool rows are 120283 generated rows, not card data
Hover, pressed, filter-active and editing states are not in the live capture

Neper renders of the grid sheets are not meaningful for the main-window sheet (the grid objects keep the v3 look set during the Windows pass, so Neper@1.5x of data_grid already showed v3 stripes; its PNG is left as committed and no Neper data_grid_main is committed)
Dialog grids: the rows' bottom 2 px hairlines (#E2E2E2/#F3F3F3) are not drawn (same gap as the main grids: the grid look has no horizontal hairline pair)

Sort dialog: the Sort Order column's A-Z / Z-A glyph is not drawn (text indented with spaces); the selected row of the Missing Set Cards list (#A6D2FF with edge) is not driven, so the sheet shows it unselected
Dialog grid column separator (#DCDCDC at the last column's right edge) and the bar's thumb (1 px right, different anti-aliasing) are close but not exact
Report windows (FastReport preview, 1296x768): the page area is the fr preview, not a Neper control; Show Columns / Customization is a plain list in a tab control; neither is reproduced
Text size 11.7 is a fitted value for Tahoma in the grid (the vertical grid and tree use 11.0); the cause of the 6 % difference is not understood
